newsitem.title: USA: CME hogs and pork bellies seen steady to lower.
newsitem.headline: CME hogs and pork bellies seen steady to lower.

text.p: CME hog and pork belly futures were expected to open steady to 0.200 cent lower, analysts said.

Carryover selling in hog futures should follow steady to lower cash hog indications. Hogs backed up from the bitter cold last week are being shipped to market and this will weigh on live and futures markets. Cash pork trade has also been slower than expected, analysts said.
However, higher cash pork prices and forecast for wintry weather conditions to return to the western corn belt and midwest areas may stimulate support, they said.
